title: MAINT: soft key lifetime not managed — C_DestroyObject/C_Finalize leak wp11_soft_key_t
description: wp11_pkcs11.c stores void *key_priv pointing to a malloc'd wp11_soft_key_t. C_DestroyObject() returns CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED without freeing the key. C_Finalize() clears the session table but does not iterate g_keys[] and call wp11_soft_key_free(). Long-running applications that create many keys leak. Fix: implement C_DestroyObject to call wp11_soft_key_free() and clear the key slot. In C_Finalize, iterate g_keys[] and free any in_use keys. Document ownership: the PKCS#11 layer owns key_priv and is responsible for its lifetime.
